name: MCIPCB11
tagline: Intel N100 industrial computer with dual Gigabit LAN and dual COM
description: MCIPCB11 combines Intel N100, DDR4 SO-DIMM memory and two Realtek RTL8111 Gigabit Ethernet ports. Two RS-232/RS-485 COM ports, HDMI, DisplayPort and display-capable Type-C connections support equipment integration. SATA and M.2 storage and wireless module slots are provided in a 138 × 126 × 48 mm enclosure.
highlights: Intel N100, 4 cores, up to 3.40 GHz, 6 MB cache
2 × HDMI + 1 × DisplayPort + 1 × USB-C with display output
